title: Spectrum
summary: Spectrum + waterfall from the mic, the LoRa-1262 or the CC1101 cap
description: Spectrum is a small, fast spectrum analyser and waterfall for three sources in one app. MIC: a 4096-point FFT of the built-in microphone with peak frequency and note name, views from 30 Hz to 24 kHz (log, linear, voice, bass, ultrasonic), zoom, and third-octave bands with an A-weighted level. RADIO: a receive-only RSSI sweep with whichever cap is attached, detected automatically: LoRa-1262 (868 SRD, 869 mesh, 915 US, 850-930 MHz) or CC1101 (433 ISM, 868 SRD, 915 US, 315 band and wide views). A signal list collects everything that rises above the noise with frequency, level, hits and last seen, and names the likely allocation (LPD433 remotes, wM-Bus, Meshtastic EU, ...). Display modes: split, spectrum, waterfall, signal list or octave bars. Peak hold, auto level with adjustable range, three colour maps, waterfall speed, freeze, and G saves a PNG screenshot plus CSV to ~/Pictures/spectrumzero. It never transmits, and it waits politely while another radio app (Camillia, LoRa Scanner, ...) owns the cap. Plain C, no dependencies beyond pw-record, about 30 fps on the Zero.
